label: games
name: Games Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR game image into one or more detailed categories based on the visible character, environment, gameplay activity, game genre, or physical game type.

labels.game_character: An image primarily showing a character, hero, avatar, or playable person from a video game.
labels.game_environment: An image primarily showing a virtual game world, level, landscape, building, or environment.
labels.action_game: An image primarily showing fast-paced video game action such as combat, movement, explosions, or adventure.
labels.shooting_game: An image primarily showing firearm-based video game combat, aiming, shooting, or battlefield action.
labels.racing_game: An image primarily showing vehicle racing, driving, tracks, or motorsport gameplay.
labels.sports_game: An image primarily showing a virtual sport such as football, cricket, basketball, tennis, or another sports game.
labels.fighting_game: An image primarily showing two or more game characters fighting in close combat or martial arts.
labels.strategy_game: An image primarily showing tactical units, armies, territories, buildings, or strategy-based gameplay.
labels.simulation_game: An image primarily showing simulated activities such as farming, building, flying, driving, or managing a virtual world.
labels.puzzle_game: An image primarily showing puzzles, matching objects, blocks, mazes, or problem-solving gameplay.
labels.board_game: A photo primarily showing a physical board game, game board, tokens, dice, or playing pieces.
labels.card_game: A photo primarily showing playing cards, collectible cards, or a physical card game.
